decisions.decisionSignature: {"id":"authorization_decision","prompt":"The welding crew is ready beside hydrocarbon equipment, but the isolation boundary and SIMOPS status were changed during the shift. What do you do first?","options":[{"id":"authorization_decision_o1","text":"Verify the permit and gas test, but rely on the operating team's radio confirmation that the revised isolation boundary is correct.","isBest":false,"quality":"defensible"},{"id":"authorization_decision_o2","text":"Stop the start, jointly verify the hot-work permit, process isolation, gas-test scope and SIMOPS conflicts before releasing the job.","isBest":true,"quality":"optimal"},{"id":"authorization_decision_o3","text":"Stage the welding set and fire watch while the permit issuer finishes checking the changed isolation and nearby operating activities.","isBest":false,"quality":"weak"},{"id":"authorization_decision_o4","text":"Begin only a short tack weld under a fire watch after one acceptable gas test while the revised isolation paperwork is completed.","isBest":false,"quality":"critical"}]}

What do you do?","options":[{"id":"changing_conditions_decision_o1","text":"Stop hot work, extinguish ignition sources, withdraw to a safe position, suspend the permit and reassess the atmosphere and SIMOPS before restart.","isBest":true,"quality":"optimal"},{"id":"changing_conditions_decision_o2","text":"Pause the arc and repeat gas testing while keeping the crew at the worksite until operations confirms whether the nearby draining will continue. and record it.","isBest":false,"quality":"defensible"},{"id":"changing_conditions_decision_o3","text":"Continue at reduced pace with continuous gas monitoring because the reading remains below the alarm set point and the fire watch is present.","isBest":false,"quality":"weak"},{"id":"changing_conditions_decision_o4","text":"Finish the current weld pass because the original gas test was acceptable, then stop for another test before starting the next pass.","isBest":false,"quality":"critical"}]}

What do you do?","options":[{"id":"emergency_decision_o1","text":"Raise the alarm and evacuate others, allowing the trained fire watch to use an extinguisher only if the fire is incipient and escape remains assured.","isBest":false,"quality":"defensible"},{"id":"emergency_decision_o2","text":"Keep the crew clear while the fire watch attacks the fire and the operator isolates the nearby process before escalating to the emergency team.","isBest":false,"quality":"weak"},{"id":"emergency_decision_o3","text":"Raise the alarm, stop work, evacuate the exposed area and let the emergency response control the fire while process energy is isolated if safe.","isBest":true,"quality":"optimal"},{"id":"emergency_decision_o4","text":"Use the available extinguisher to control the growing fire first, then raise the alarm if it cannot be contained without leaving the work area.","isBest":false,"quality":"critical"}]}

Raise the alarm and evacuate others, allowing the trained fire watch to use an extinguisher only if the fire is incipient and escape remains assured.

decisions.decisionSignature: {"id":"closeout_decision","prompt":"The fire is controlled and no one is injured. Production wants the weld completed before the end of the shift. How should the job be recovered?","options":[{"id":"closeout_decision_o1","text":"Keep the task stopped, correct the immediate deficiencies, repeat gas testing and complete a controlled permit review before resuming the weld. under supervision.","isBest":false,"quality":"defensible"},{"id":"closeout_decision_o2","text":"Keep the permit suspended, investigate the ignition path, inspect concealed fire spread, restore controls and issue a new authorization only after verification.","isBest":true,"quality":"optimal"},{"id":"closeout_decision_o3","text":"Resume after the atmosphere is acceptable, damaged lagging is removed and the crew receives a focused re-brief on the fire-watch arrangements.","isBest":false,"quality":"weak"},{"id":"closeout_decision_o4","text":"Resume once ventilation clears the smoke and a replacement extinguisher is in position because the remaining weld time is short.","isBest":false,"quality":"critical"}]}
